question.text: In <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>6</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub></math> , the number of oxygen atoms bonded to each phosphorus atoms are respectively‐

solution.text: In P4O6 each phosphorus is linked to three oxygen atoms; whereas in P4O10 each phosphorus atom is linked to four oxygen atoms.
